description: Source-pinned historical descriptors adopted by the Ashen provisional runtime. This is a reconstruction, not byte-identical recovery and not a target-game rules profile.

official_3755930_v0.2.78.retrieval_note: Official community page exposes the English v0.2.78 patch in a Russian-language page shell. The previously cited allnews route failed extraction in this research pass.

official_4129400_v0.1.137.retrieval_note: Official Steam announcement feed identifies The Severed Gods Playtest, author quan.le, version v0.1.137. The source ID preserves the compatibility API's playtest app identity.

defend.mp_grant.locator: v0.2.78 > Gameplay & Balance > Defend MP change
defend.mp_grant.summary: Defend's nominal MP grant was raised from 10 to 15 in this historical patch.
defend.mp_grant.limitations: Does not establish timing, caps, costs, mitigation, duration, modifiers, recipient selection, or validity in EA 0.2.102.

counter.normal_attack_relic_event.summary: A counter using a normal attack triggers normal-attack relics in this historical patch.
counter.normal_attack_relic_event.limitations: Only emits the event descriptor; no automatic relic benefit, relic inventory, MP amount, trigger ordering, counter targeting, or universal counter mechanics are implied.

parry.successful_action_scope.locator: v0.1.137 > Balance / Tuning > Updated Parry behavior
parry.successful_action_scope.summary: Following a successful Parry, the historical patch permits the Hero to act and excludes NPC actions.
parry.successful_action_scope.limitations: The caller must already have resolved success. Does not calculate success, cost, failure behavior, action count, queue insertion or order.
